physics_goals.quote: Same right-side-up (RSU) mechanical design validated by PICO-40L, scaled up rather than re-engineered
physics_goals.value: Spin-dependent WIMP-proton scattering with a right-side-up C3F8 bubble chamber (proof of concept for PICO-500)

summary.plain: PICO-40L is the PICO team's current bubble chamber at SNOLAB: a jar of about 70 kg of superheated C3F8 refrigerant turned 'right-side-up' so no water buffer touches the target. It is running now; no physics-results paper has appeared yet.
summary.technical: Right-side-up (RSU) bubble chamber with two concentric nested quartz jars connected by bellows, ~70 kg C3F8, four cameras, 12 piezoelectric transducers and two Dytran pressure transducers, in the water tank formerly used for PICO-60; designed for thermodynamic thresholds as low as 2.8 keV. Construction 2019-2020, updates 2021-2022, commissioning and operations from 2023. As of the July 2026 DPF talk 'a dedicated PICO-40L detector paper is coming out soon'; the official publications list (December 2025) has no PICO-40L physics paper.
